purpose: Standalone RGBA banner for the front login page, based on the approved low-glow mockup.
initial_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG header banner for the Stellar Syndicates game's login page.

Image 1 is the approved login-page mockup. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the branding lockup immediately above the login card: the single-S emblem at the left and the two-line STELLAR SYNDICATES title at the right. Image 2 is a higher-resolution reference for that same approved single-S emblem; use it to preserve the emblem's details faithfully.

Deliver ONLY this isolated emblem-and-wordmark on a genuinely transparent background, at high resolution. This is the standalone banner asset that will be overlaid onto the existing web page, not another screenshot or mockup.

Composition: wide horizontal lockup, about 3.6:1 overall aspect ratio, ideally around 2048 x 576. Match the proportions and spacing in Image 1 closely: compact emblem on the left, a modest clear gap, two lines of title at the right, vertically centered as one unit. The emblem is approximately 1.6 times the combined height of the two text lines and occupies about one quarter of the lockup width. Tight but comfortable transparent padding around the complete silhouette, approximately 3% of canvas width. No clipping of the emblem's tips, orbital ring, letter edges or subtle edge antialiasing. Do not leave a full-screen canvas with a tiny logo in it.

Emblem invariants: exactly the supplied single angular metallic S inside its dark beveled hexagonal frame, cyan central four-point star and orbital ellipse, small gold pointed top accent and red pointed lower accent. Keep one S only. Preserve dark metal surfaces and dark recessed interior as part of the emblem, while everything outside its silhouette is transparent.

Wordmark invariants: preserve the exact typography in Image 1, including its extended squared uppercase letterforms, generous tracking, proportions, beveled edges, line spacing and optical alignment. Match the two line widths by making the upper line's letters larger and the lower line's letters a little smaller. The exact text is:
STELLAR
SYNDICATES
Spell it exactly. The title must look like the restrained silver title from the mockup, not the earlier heavy cinematic banner. Use clean brushed silver/titanium faces and neutral silver-white highlights. Keep only a very faint cool edge reflection on the letters. There should be essentially NO diffuse blue outer glow, cyan haze, blue cloud, neon halo, blue underline or flare around the words. Retain the cyan star and ring on the emblem.

Transparency is critical: preserve real RGBA alpha. All exterior space, the gap between emblem and title, spaces between letters, and the holes inside letters must be genuinely transparent. Keep clean antialiased edges with no black/blue matte rectangle, no opaque shadow plate, no white fringe and no baked checkerboard. Any tiny residual glow on the emblem fades smoothly to transparent.

Exclude all screenshot content: no login card, buttons, interface text, starfield, background stars, nebula, planet, ships, wormhole or scenery. No extra words, taglines, labels, borders, other logos, mockup presentation or watermark. Output one complete transparent banner.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the transparent Stellar Syndicates banner to refine. Image 2 is the approved mockup, used ONLY as the reference for the restrained silver wordmark finish and typography. Do not include any page content from Image 2.

Fix the wordmark's edges and finish. Remove ALL of the stray saturated cyan, electric-blue and green fringe pixels, blue glow patches and colored extraction artifacts around and between the letters of STELLAR SYNDICATES. This includes the small bright blue/green flares above letters and the colored patches in letter holes. Replace these with either clean neutral silver bevel edges that belong to the glyph, or true fully transparent background outside the glyph. The title lettering should have NO blue outer glow and NO cyan outlines.

Match the quieter typography in Image 2: clean bright brushed silver faces, shallow neutral silver-white bevels and restrained dark metallic side faces. Reduce the chunky extrusion slightly so the words feel crisp and refined, rather than like heavily inflated 3D letters. Keep the exact two-line text, letter shapes, line widths, alignment and tracking:
STELLAR
SYNDICATES

Keep the single-S emblem from Image 1 faithful: same hexagon, one S, bright cyan star and orbital ellipse, gold top accent and red bottom accent. The emblem's cyan is intentional and should remain. All blue-fringe cleanup applies to the WORDS, not the emblem.

Transparency requirements: genuine RGBA. All metal faces and solid parts of the lettering and badge must be opaque. Only the narrow antialiased contour and the emblem's subtle glow transition through partial alpha. Exterior space, gap between emblem and title, spaces between letters and all letter counter holes are fully transparent. No black or blue matte, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no opaque rectangle or drop-shadow plate.

Frame the finished isolated banner as a tightly fitted wide landscape asset with about 20 to 30 pixels of transparent padding beyond the overall artwork on each side, rather than large unused margins. Preserve the horizontal emblem-plus-wordmark layout, with the emblem vertically centered against both words and a modest clear gap. Preserve every tip and orbital curve without clipping. Nothing else in the image.
export: Crop only empty exterior space, preserve all generated RGBA artwork and antialiasing, and retain 16 pixels of transparent margin.
